Requirement: The controller shall publish a complete joint-position command vector at the configured control rate (default 200 Hz).
The joint_cmd payload shall be a Float32 vector of joint positions in radians, ordered by the latched actuator map, one element per active joint.
Every joint_cmd element shall be clamped to the joint's configured mechanical min/max before it is published.
No joint_cmd shall be published before the latched robot_config has been received.
The Dynamixel interface shall publish joint_feedback at the hardware loop rate (default 100 Hz), latest-sample-only.
The controller shall tolerate missing or late joint_feedback frames without commanding an uncommanded manoeuvre.
The camera interface shall republish frames at no more than the configured cap (default 15 Hz).
AprilTag detections shall be produced at the detector rate (default 30 Hz) and carry a timestamp.
The controller shall ignore detections older than the configured staleness threshold (default 0.5 s).
The IMU interface shall publish imu_data at the configured sample rate (default 100 Hz) as sensor_msgs/Imu.
robot_config shall be published once on a latched (transient-local, depth 1) topic so any node that starts later still receives the configuration.
mission_status shall be published on each state change and rate-limited to a minimum spacing (default 5 Hz).
Malformed mission_input messages shall be rejected without crashing the dispatcher and without commanding the propulsors.
The servo bus shall run Dynamixel Protocol 2.0 over RS-485 at 1 Mbaud via the U2D2 adapter, addressing four servos.
The IMU shall be addressed on I2C at 0x69.
mission_cmd shall carry exactly one active mission and the controller shall act only on the most recent message.
telemetry shall be a Float32 vector for monitoring only; its loss shall not affect vehicle control.
The camera shall stream over USB UVC and the camera interface shall recover the stream on disconnect without crashing.
